skill.name: research-grants
skill.description: Draft and refine research grant proposals for NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA. Use agency-specific guidance for proposal structure, review criteria, budgets, timelines, broader impacts, and resubmissions.
skill.summary: Draft agency-specific research grant proposals with templates, review guidance, and budget planning support.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most reconnaissance and backtick matches are false positives from grant-writing prose, markdown fences, and file references. One real medium-risk issue remains: the skill allows Bash and includes a bash command for schematic generation. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Bash execution is recommended for schematic generation.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the bash command or replace it with instructions to use reviewed, packaged tools only.

remediation.issue: Tool permissions include Bash for a document-writing skill.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed-tools unless a reviewed script is packaged and required for core functionality.

remediation.issue: Several referenced helper scripts are not included in the package.
remediation.suggestion: Include and audit the helper scripts, or remove script references from the documentation.

- Acknowledge valid criticisms and explain how addressed
- **Substance Use and Mental Health**: Opioid crisis, addiction, mental health

- ❌ No metrics: No way to assess success

For detailed methodology guidance by discipline, refer to `references/research_methods.md`.
For detailed budget guidance, refer to `references/budget_preparation.md`.
For detailed review criteria by agency, refer to `references/review_criteria.md`.
For detailed program guidance, refer to `references/funding_mechanisms.md`.
For detailed resubmission guidance, refer to `references/resubmission_strategies.md`.
- `references/nih_guidelines.md`: NIH mechanisms, review criteria, and submission requirements
- `references/doe_guidelines.md`: DOE programs, emphasis areas, and application procedures
- `references/darpa_guidelines.md`: DARPA BAAs, program offices, and proposal strategies
- `references/broader_impacts.md`: Strategies for compelling broader impacts statements
- `references/resubmission_strategies.md`: Responding to reviews and revising proposals
- `scripts/budget_calculator.py`: Calculate budgets with inflation and fringe
- Use accessible language (avoid jargon in opening sentences)
- Avoid over-interpreting or overstating preliminary findings
- Avoid jargon when possible; explain when necessary
- Use precise language (avoid vague terms like "several," "various")
- Addresses important problem or critical barrier to progress
- Show that you've thought through the research process

content.value_statement: Researchers must match each proposal to strict agency review expectations. This skill helps draft, review, and structure grant materials for major U.S. funders.
actual_capabilities: Drafts NSF project summaries with Overview, Intellectual Merit, and Broader Impacts sections.
Helps structure NIH Specific Aims pages and research strategy sections.
Explains DOE and DARPA proposal priorities, review criteria, and expected deliverables.
Supports budget justification planning for personnel, equipment, travel, and supplies.
Guides timeline, milestone, team, and resubmission planning for research proposals.
Provides reusable templates for NSF summaries, NIH aims, and budget narratives.
limitations: It does not replace current agency solicitations or official submission instructions.
It cannot verify institutional rates, legal terms, or final budget approval.
It needs user-provided research details, deadlines, and program requirements.
Some referenced helper scripts are not included in the packaged files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Federal Proposal
use_cases.description: Build a clear proposal outline, identify required sections, and avoid common first-submission mistakes.

use_cases.title: Strengthen Agency Fit
use_cases.description: Adapt the same research idea for NSF, NIH, DOE, or DARPA review priorities.

use_cases.title: Improve Resubmission Strategy
use_cases.description: Organize reviewer feedback, revise weak sections, and prepare a focused response plan.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Right Proposal Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me outline a research grant proposal for [agency] and [program]. My project studies [topic], and the deadline is [date].

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Specific Aims Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an NIH Specific Aims page for this project: [project summary]. Include significance, hypothesis, aims, expected outcomes, and impact.

prompt_templates.title: Review Broader Impacts
prompt_templates.scenario: Improving an NSF section before internal review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my NSF broader impacts section for specificity, feasibility, assessment metrics, and connection to the research plan: [paste section].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Agency Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA fit for this research concept: [concept]. Recommend positioning, proposal sections, risks, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Help me plan an NSF project summary for a climate modeling proposal.
output: A summary outline with Overview, Intellectual Merit, and Broader Impacts sections.
Suggested plain-language framing for non-specialist reviewers.
Measurable broader impacts activities linked to education and public benefit.

output_examples.input: Review my NIH Specific Aims page for clarity and impact.
output: Comments on significance, innovation, aim independence, and expected outcomes.
A revised aims structure with clearer logic and less jargon.
A short checklist for final page-length and readability review.

output_examples.input: Create a budget justification outline for a three-year research project.
output: Personnel, equipment, travel, supplies, and subaward justification sections.
Questions to confirm institutional rates and sponsor restrictions.
A review list for consistency between budget, timeline, and project activities.

best_practices: Provide the current solicitation, agency, mechanism, deadline, and page limits before drafting.
Ask for reviewer-focused revisions after each major section is drafted.
Verify all budgets, compliance items, and formatting against official agency instructions.
anti_patterns: Do not use generic proposal text without linking it to agency review criteria.
Do not invent preliminary data, collaborations, facilities, or budget rates.
Do not rely on this skill for final compliance review without official documents.

faq.question: Which funding agencies does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA, with separate guidance for each agency.

faq.question: Can it write a complete proposal?
faq.answer: It can draft and revise proposal sections, but users must provide research details and verify official requirements.

faq.question: Does it support NIH Specific Aims pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for aims, significance, hypothesis, expected outcomes, and impact.

faq.question: Can it help with NSF broader impacts?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps make broader impacts specific, measurable, feasible, and connected to the research plan.

faq.question: Does it calculate final budgets?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure justifications, but institutional rates and sponsor rules require local verification.

faq.question: Is it suitable for resubmissions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help organize reviewer comments, identify weak sections, and plan revisions.
